content.text: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full, and no other section creates a vendor exit on our change of control.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 sits at our preferred position. Customer may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (24.1, notice only); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Customer competitor (24.2); other assignments are subject to a mutual reasonableness consent standard (24.3); and 24.4 expressly bars any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Cross-check of Section 9 termination triggers shows no change-of-control or assignment-based Vendor termination right (9.2 covers insolvency only and expressly excludes a lawful reorganization that does not impair performance), and Section 13.4 confirms licence rights transfer with a Section 24 permitted assignment. No redline required.
